suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Accommodate verification-only or documentation-only features where no code changes are needed. The EndFeatureRun commitId requirement forces workers on no-op tasks to either return 'partial' success or reference an unrelated commit. Consider allowing 'success' without commitId when a worker verifies work was already done.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature update-tasks-md-mqtt had two worker sessions. Worker 1 returned 'partial' because no commit existed. Worker 2 referenced commit 13b8c6c (a core-cleanup validation commit) as a workaround. Both correctly identified all MQTT items were already checked off.
